confirmed_task:
On the USGS monitoring-location page for USGS-01646500, use Continuous Data to report the station name and the latest displayed Discharge, cubic feet per second and Gage height, feet observations. For each observation report its value, unit, and timestamp as displayed at run time.

Stopping condition: Stop after the station name and both latest Continuous Data observations, including values, units, and timestamps, have been recorded.

Constraints:
- Use only monitoring location USGS-01646500.
- Use the latest displayed observation for each named data type, not a daily statistic or the data-date-range endpoints.
- If only one series is graphed initially, use the Continuous Data controls to display the other.
- Preserve provisional labels if they are shown and do not convert units or time zones.

items.criterion: Use the correct USGS monitoring location (USGS-01646500) and Continuous Data section
items.description: Agent navigates to the USGS monitoring-location page for USGS-01646500 and uses the Continuous Data display (not daily stats or unrelated sections) as the basis for the reported observations. Full credit if the agent attempts to access USGS-01646500 Continuous Data and (a) successfully uses it, OR (b) clearly reports that the USGS page/widget is inaccessible (e.g., outage, captcha/bot block) or the Continuous Data section fails to load after reasonable retry. Partial credit if the correct station is used but the agent mixes in non-continuous products while still extracting the latest continuous observations. No credit if data are taken from a different station/site number without noting an access issue.

Agent records the station name exactly as shown on the USGS-01646500 monitoring-location page at run time. Full credit for correct station name. Partial credit if mostly correct but with minor transcription error. If the station name cannot be viewed due to page access/loading issues, full credit if the agent clearly states that the name was not visible because the page/widget did not load or access was blocked (after attempting to load it). No credit if station name is missing without explanation or is from the wrong station.

items.criterion: Latest Continuous Data observation: Discharge (cubic feet per second)
items.description: Agent reports the latest displayed (most recent) Continuous Data observation for 'Discharge, cubic feet per second' including: value, unit (as displayed), and timestamp (as displayed, without converting time zone). Must be the latest plotted/displayed observation, not a daily statistic or date-range endpoint. Full credit if all three fields match the display. If the discharge series is not available/displayed due to external factors (e.g., parameter not offered, temporary data outage, series fails to render), full credit if the agent clearly reports that the latest discharge observation is not shown/available in Continuous Data at run time after attempting to display it. Partial credit if the correct series is used but one field (value/unit/timestamp) is missing or slightly mis-copied.

items.criterion: Latest Continuous Data observation: Gage height (feet)
items.description: Agent reports the latest displayed (most recent) Continuous Data observation for 'Gage height, feet' including: value, unit (as displayed), and timestamp (as displayed, without converting time zone). Must be the latest plotted/displayed observation, not a daily statistic or date-range endpoint. Full credit if all three fields match the display. If the gage-height series is not available/displayed due to external factors (e.g., parameter not offered, temporary data outage, series fails to render), full credit if the agent clearly reports that the latest gage-height observation is not shown/available in Continuous Data at run time after attempting to display it. Partial credit if the correct series is used but one field (value/unit/timestamp) is missing or slightly mis-copied.

items.criterion: Display both series if not initially shown; preserve provisional labels and stop after required reporting
items.description: If only one series is graphed initially, agent uses the Continuous Data controls to display the other before capturing the latest observation(s), when those controls are available and functioning. Agent preserves any 'Provisional' labels exactly as shown and does not convert units/time zones. Agent stops after recording station name and both latest observations (or clearly stating unavailability as allowed above), without adding unrelated outputs. Full credit if the agent follows these constraints or if controls/series toggles are missing/broken and the agent clearly reports that limitation while still capturing any available required observation(s). Partial credit if both observations are obtained but the control-use is unclear when needed or a provisional label is omitted when present.
